content:
The location of the function source code.
JSON representation
Fields
Union field source. Location of the source. At least one source needs to be provided for the deployment to
succeed. source can be only one of the following:
storageSource
object (StorageSource
(/functions/docs/reference/rest/v2/projects.locations.functions#StorageSource))
If provided, get the source from this location in Google Cloud Storage.
repoSource
object (RepoSource
(/functions/docs/reference/rest/v2/projects.locations.functions#RepoSource))
If provided, get the source from this location in a Cloud Source Repository.
gitUri
string
If provided, get the source from GitHub repository. This option is valid only for GCF 1st
Gen function. Example: https://github.com/ (https://github.com/)//blob//
